items.text: Account area: Profile, Security, Sessions, Notifications and Activity.
Help center: FAQ, About, Product overview, Support, Diagnostics, Terms and Privacy.
User menu and notification panel in the top bar.
Search now finds account pages, help articles and commands.
Sign-in checkboxes can now be reached and toggled with the keyboard.
Sign in, create account, email verification, password recovery and two-factor screens.
Motion modes FULL, REDUCED and OFF.
Brand panel and form scale for 1440, 1600 and 1920 wide windows.
Trading desk adds context columns at larger window sizes instead of stretching the chart.
Status dock groups system health, mode and environment.
Rail labels and dock text are larger and easier to read.
